mapper.sql: id,notice_id AS noticeId,source_attachment_id AS sourceAttachmentId,organization_name AS organizationName,department_name AS departmentName,position_name AS positionName,position_code AS positionCode,recruit_count AS recruitCount,work_location AS workLocation,education_requirement AS educationRequirement,degree_requirement AS degreeRequirement,major_requirement AS majorRequirement,age_requirement AS ageRequirement,work_years_requirement AS workYearsRequirement,responsibility,other_requirement AS otherRequirement,preferred_requirement AS preferredRequirement,raw_requirement AS rawRequirement,source_sheet AS sourceSheet,source_row AS sourceRow,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt
